propositions: PyPI dependency resolution in the clean-wheel optionality lane installs MCP 2.0.0, which is outside the supported constraint mcp>=1.28.1,<2 declared in pyproject.toml
The rebar codebase imports mcp.server.fastmcp, which is not provided by MCP 2.0, causing CI test failures independent of the patchset
The optionality workflow currently installs unbounded mcp without version pinning, allowing major version drift from the project's declared support window
The workflow must constrain MCP installation to the same supported version interval as pyproject.toml while preserving the lane contract of testing the core wheel without extras
Workflow YAML must pass linting and the optionality lane must verify both that MCP 2.x cannot be resolved and that the agents extra remains absent
